# Legacy Prompt Migration Plan

## Batch 0: Governance foundation

Implement the execution envelope, rule ingestion, provenance, AI ledger, approval gates, sandbox,
credential gateway, WebResearchGateway, timeout, retry, budgets, and audit events before migrating
autonomous prompts.

Also implement zero-config discovery and manual fallbacks before enabling optional integrations.
Add the human-output renderer only after evidence, synthetic-data, and disclosure checks.

## Batch 1: Modeling competition core

Migrate:

`assets-inventory -> comp-prob-analysis -> comp-modeling -> comp-code -> paper-figure -> comp-paper-* -> comp-compile-* -> quality-check`

Replace Bash assumptions with platform adapters. Add current-rule profiles and synthetic-data gates.

## Batch 2: Research and evidence

Migrate literature, novelty, experiment planning, result-to-claim, ablation, paper planning, writing,
review, rebuttal, slides, and posters. Enforce citation verification and claim-evidence links.

## Batch 3: Innovation and entrepreneurship

Use the new innovation skills in this plugin. Reuse selected research and presentation skills only
through the evidence layer.

## Batch 4: High-risk automation

Migrate remote experiment runners, training monitors, autonomous review loops, notifications, and
external APIs last. Split plan from execute, add compensating actions, and require explicit approval.

## Batch 5: Optional extensions

Pixel art, specialized Nature styling, communications-only literature review, and provider-specific
review loops should remain optional modules rather than default dependencies.
